audit.join_method: unique one-to-one continuous interrupt-ID window with bounded timestamp error
audit.interpretation: This is a timestamp/order join to a unique continuous PM4 interrupt window. Process 1 records callbacks observed inside the guest wrapper; Process 2 records the outer guest callback and data passed to ExecuteInterrupt. This does not prove callback payload or guest semantic equivalence.

limits: P1 records callback targets reached inside the guest wrapper; P2 records the outer CPU-dispatched wrapper passed to ExecuteInterrupt.
Timestamp/order correlation does not prove callback payload equivalence, guest semantic completion, or that every interrupt represents a unique GPU completion.
The captured retail operation log still rejects the overlapping EDRAM view change at packet 27; accepted draw submissions and interrupt correlation do not establish pixel parity.
